result.markdown: --- engine: knitr --- # Functions ![](/images/dna.png){style="width:200px; background:white; border-radius:5px" fig-align="center"} A __function__ is a distinct piece of code which requires data for it to run. To run a __function__ you need the name of the __function__ followed by a pair of braces (`()`) with the desired input within the braces. We have already used some __functions__: - __`int()`__ - __`str()`__ - __`float()`__ - __`type()`__ Imagine that we need to find the length of a __string__ of nucleotides (i.e. how many bases are in a piece of DNA). In this instance, we can use the built-in `len()` __function__ on the __string__: __Note__: Use any __string__ of 'ACGT' you like, no need to copy this one exactly. ::: {.cell} ```{.python .cell-code} #Random DNA sequence DNA1 = "ACGTGTTATATGCGCGTTAGTGTAGTCGATC" #print the length of the DNA len(DNA1) ``` ::: Make another random length of DNA and check its length: ::: {.cell} ```{.python .cell-code} #Random DNA sequence DNA2 = "AGCTGACTGCATGATTGCTGATCAACAGT" #print the length of the DNA len(DNA2) ``` ::: You can use the `+` __operator__ to paste 2 or more __strings__ together which is useful. ::: {.cell} ```{.python .cell-code} DNA3 = DNA1 + DNA2 DNA3 ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.python .cell-code} len(DNA3) ``` ::: The below code incorporates previously made __variables__ and used __functions__. Make a good attempt to understand it. You can try running smaller parts of the code to more easily see what each part is doing (e.g. only run `str(X)`). If you are unsure please ask a demonstrator, they are more than happy to help. ::: {.cell} ```{.python .cell-code} maths_sentence = str(X) + " + " + str(V) + " = " + str(X + V) maths_sentence ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.python .cell-code} len(maths_sentence) ``` ::: You'll notice that each character (including spaces ` `) adds to the length. ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html} ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html} ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html} ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html} ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html} ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html} ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html} ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html} ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html} ``` ::: :::
